notes.rev0: FY26 sales guide $5.63-5.71B, midpoint 5,670 (8-K 2.9.2026). H1 actual 2,547.1; Q3 guide 1,210-1,230; implied Q4 1,853-1,953. Consensus 5,714 (Alpha Vantage, 24 analysts) sits at the guide top: not used for the base.
notes.growth: drivers_build.py: sales = existing stores (prior sales x (1 + 0.95 x comp)) + new stores (prior sales x k x growth of the average store count). Base: comps +3.5% then +3%, 150 net new stores a year (FY25 and FY26 pace), k 0.95 -> FY27 6,263 (consensus 6,243). Bull: FY26 lands 2.5% above the guide midpoint (last four quarters beat the sales midpoint by 6-8%), comps +6/+5/+4.5/+4, 175-200 stores, k 1.0. Bear: comps -3/-1/+1/+2 (FY22 -2.0% after +30%; FY24 -2.7%), openings cut to 120/90/70, k 0.88.
notes.margin: operating margin after stock compensation (the company's adjusted operating income keeps regular stock compensation as a cost; it excludes only the tariff refund, retention awards and small one-offs). FY26 guide: adjusted net income 546-572 (mid 559) / 0.755 - interest income ~34 = adjusted operating income ~706 = 12.5% of 5,670 (call summary: 'about 12.5%'). The $163.6M IEEPA refund and $5.9M interest are out. History (SEC companyfacts): FY2014-19 11.2-12.3%, FY2021 13.3% (peak), FY2024 8.4% (adjusted 9.2%), FY2025 9.6% (adjusted 9.9%). Base 12.3% -> 12.5% (consensus FY27 implies ~12.3%); bull to 14.2% (above the 13.3% peak, on sales per store above $3.4M); bear to 9.0% (the FY2024 trough).
notes.conv: FCF after stock compensation / NOPAT. FY25: (411.7 - 34.7) / 341.7 = 1.10 (capex 174.7 below D&A 192.1); FY24 0.38 and FY23 0.51 (shipcenter build, capex 8-9% of sales). FY26: NOPAT ~530 + D&A ~208 - capex 255 - working capital ~40 = ~445 -> 0.84. Capex FY27 ~5.0% of sales (management: refund reinvested mostly through capex; remodels $40-45K a store; ~150 stores ~$100M) fading to ~4.2% vs D&A ~3.6-3.7% (vintages: gross PP&E 2,155 / D&A 192 = ~11-year life; no D&A wave), working capital ~40 a year (inventory per store up 18%).
notes.net_cash: 1.8.2026 cash 561.1 + short-term investments 626.8 = 1,187.9; no debt ($225M ABL undrawn). H2 FY26: net income ~342 (guide) + D&A 106 + stock comp 17 - working capital ~30 - capex ~145 = FCF ~290 (H2 FY25: +262 change in cash and investments) - tax withholding ~5 -> ~1,470 at 30.1.2027, before any buyback (the guide excludes buybacks). The refund cash (169.5 pre-tax) is already inside the 1,187.9. Operating lease liabilities 2,038.6 are NOT deducted: rent (lease cost 449.9 in FY25) stays in cost of goods sold.
notes.shares: 55.05M outstanding on 2.9.2026 (10-Q cover) + ~0.35M dilutive RSU/PSU = 55.4M (Q3 guide 55.4M diluted). Flat in every scenario: stock compensation (34.7 in FY25, 0.7% of sales) is expensed in the margin; the $600M buyback authorization (29.8.2026, ~4.4% of the market value, no expiry) is carried as retained cash, which is the same value when shares are bought at fair value. No converts, options or warrants.
notes.beta: 2-year weekly vs SPY (104 returns to 9.11.2026): raw 1.613 -> adjusted 0.67 x raw + 0.33 = 1.411 (deep/beta.py). beta_mature 1.0 (convention).
notes.rf_erp: rf 5.10% = 10-year Treasury 12.11.2026 (FRED DGS10); erp 4.2% = implied ERP 1.10.2026 (Damodaran), as in the saved params. Index return 9.3%.
notes.roic_terminal: 0.30: book return on invested capital excluding leases and cash (rent is an operating cost): FY26 NOPAT ~530 / (equity 2,476 - cash and investments 1,188) = ~41% at a record margin; FY25 ~28%; FY24 roughly 20%. Through-cycle ~0.30. New-store model: $0.4M net investment, ~$2.0M first-year sales, payback about one year (10-K).
notes.pe: exit P/E on next-year operating EPS. Own forward P/E, 60 month-ends 11.2021-10.2026: median 23.9, p25 17.0, p75 33.9 (deep/multiple_history.py; actual EPS, not consensus at the time). Stated fact against using 23.9 as is: the 25-44x of 2021-24 belonged to ~15% yearly store growth (1,340 -> 1,771 stores FY22-FY24); at the horizon store growth is ~5.5% and sales growth ~8%; the last-24-month median is ~17x. Base 22 (sensitivity at 23.9 in valuation.md), bull 26, bear 15 (own 2024-25 trough 10-16x).
notes.charge: judgement, not disclosed amounts: no accrual in the filings. Securities class action (class certified 3.8.2026) and consumer class actions over IEEPA tariff pass-through (filed 6-7.2026; the refund was 163.6 pre-tax). Base 40 after tax in FY28; bear 170 (the refund disgorged ~123 after tax + ~47 securities); bull 20.
notes.calibrated: default: holds today's price / FY27 operating EPS. Not overridden: earnings are not depressed (record gross margin), so the multiple is not inflated; the lens differs from the base only by the multiple.
